key.name: full-battery-action
key.description: What happens once the battery has stayed full for full-wait minutes: off (nothing), notify (offer to switch to Preserve Battery Health) or switch (switch to Preserve Battery Health).

key.name: full-wait
key.summary: Wait before the Full-battery action, in minutes
key.description: How long the battery stays full before the Full-battery action runs. 0 acts as soon as it is full.

key.name: renotify-interval
key.description: Notify only: the time from one notification to the next. 0 notifies once, with no reminders.

key.name: show-top-bar-icon
key.description: Whether the top bar shows the extension's icon while Preserve Battery Health is on. It never shows on the lock screen.
